channel.title: Joseph Yaw Agyeman - Blog
channel.description: Articles on software engineering, AI/ML, system design, and building production systems.

item.title: The Rise of AI Agents: Building Autonomous Systems That Actually Work
item.description: A deep dive into AI agent architectures — from simple ReAct loops to multi-agent orchestration. Practical patterns for building agents that reason, use tools, and solve real problems.

item.title: AI-Assisted Development: How I Actually Use AI to Write Better Code
item.description: Beyond autocomplete — a honest look at how AI tools fit into a real development workflow. When to lean on them, when to think for yourself, and the prompting patterns that actually work.

item.title: Building Scalable APIs with Django REST Framework
item.description: A practical guide to designing and building production-ready REST APIs with Django REST Framework, covering serializers, viewsets, authentication, and performance optimization.

item.title: Building RAG Applications: From Naive Search to Production Pipeline
item.description: A practical guide to building Retrieval-Augmented Generation systems that actually work. Covers embedding strategies, chunking, vector databases, re-ranking, and the pitfalls that tutorials skip.

item.title: Fine-Tuning LLMs: When You Need It and How to Do It Right
item.description: A practical guide to fine-tuning large language models. When fine-tuning beats prompting, how to prepare datasets, LoRA vs full fine-tuning, and evaluation strategies that prevent shipping a worse model.

item.title: Clean Code That Actually Matters: Principles I Follow After 5 Years of Production Code
item.description: Not another 'use meaningful variable names' article. These are the clean code principles that actually prevent production incidents, reduce PR review time, and make codebases a joy to work in.

item.title: From Monolith to Microservices: Lessons Learned
item.description: Real-world lessons from migrating a Django monolith to a microservices architecture using Docker, Kubernetes, and event-driven communication.

item.title: System Design Fundamentals Every Developer Should Know
item.description: The system design concepts that matter most in real-world engineering — load balancing, caching, database scaling, message queues, and how to think about trade-offs. No whiteboard interview fluff.

item.title: TypeScript Patterns That Make Your Code Bulletproof
item.description: Advanced TypeScript patterns for real-world applications — discriminated unions, branded types, type-safe event systems, and builder patterns that catch bugs at compile time instead of production.

item.title: Deploying ML Models to Production: What They Don't Teach in Tutorials
item.description: The gap between a Jupyter notebook and a production ML system is massive. Covering model serving, monitoring, feature stores, A/B testing, and the operational patterns that keep ML systems reliable.

item.title: The Future of Full-Stack Development in the Age of AI
item.description: How AI is reshaping what it means to be a full-stack developer. The skills that are becoming more valuable, the ones becoming commoditized, and how to position yourself for the next decade.

item.title: CI/CD Pipelines That Actually Work: A Practical Guide
item.description: How to build CI/CD pipelines that are fast, reliable, and don't make your team dread merging code. Covering GitHub Actions, testing strategies, deployment patterns, and the common mistakes that slow teams down.
